description:
A drum groove built from nested sub-services, where a pipeline's length in time is the sum of the waits inside it.

Four patterns — Straight, Shuffle, Four on the floor and Funk — each a **Bar** of four **Beats**, and each beat a list of **Notes**, the one block the board defines. A Note waits, plays one drum at a volume, and waits again; its two waits are its own stretch of the bar, so each note can be read and changed without looking at its neighbours. A Note with no wait after it sounds together with the next one. The Shuffle swings by giving every second hi-hat a wait before it, inside the same half beat a straight eighth takes.

Every wait is measured in beats. The tempo and the chosen pattern are slots in the outermost scope, the **Groove**. Each bar reads the pattern and a Switch routes the bar into it; every scope inside inherits the Groove's slots, so a Note reads the tempo from its surroundings without knowing where it is set.

blocks.name: Note
blocks.description: One sound in its own stretch of time: a wait, the sound, and a wait. The two waits, in beats, are how long the note lasts and where in it the sound falls; either may be zero.

items.placeholder: Each pattern is a bar of four beats, and each beat a list of notes: a wait, a drum, and a wait. Every wait is in beats; the tempo and the pattern are slots in the outermost scope, and a pattern change lands on the next bar.
